verdict.rationale: HMRC runs online services, an app and an API platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers only tax registration, Making Tax Digital sign-up, the API probe and robots.txt, and nothing about analytics, cookies or tracking opt-out controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
